title: Load Shedding Advisory
role: Public Information Officer, MahaTransco (coordination with DISCOM field offices)
context: Planned maintenance on a 220 kV bay may cause supply interruptions in selected areas tonight between 22:00 and 02:00 IST. Hospitals and critical installations are being informed via circle offices. Rumours are already circulating on WhatsApp with wrong timings.
task: Draft a citizen-facing public advisory suitable for website, press note, and official WhatsApp broadcast. Clarify that updates come only from official channels.
constraints: Under 180 words. Calm, non-alarmist tone. No invented feeder names or phone numbers. Distinguish TRANSco planned work vs any DISCOM distribution messaging using placeholders if needed. Include [VERIFY] for any missing fact.
format: Short paragraphs: What / When / Why / What citizens should do / Official update source / Apology line.
